metadata.title: Why Tea tribes matter in Assam Elections । टी ट्राइब और असम चुनाव । The Adivasi Question
metadata.description:
All major political parties have made many promises and announcements for the Tea Tribes and Ex Tea tribes of Assam before the state Assembly Elections. These tribes were brought to the state in the year 1820 and after, from different states, to work in Assam's tea gardens. But even after 200 years, these tribes are continuing to fight for their identity and constitutional rights in the state of Assam.
In this episode, we try to understand the issues related to these tribes.

Anchor: Smitha Nair

For all the updates about our upcoming videos, follow us on social media:
